headline: Dominion and NextEra Energy Merger Faces Opposition in Virginia
summary: Virginia Governor Abigail Spanberger warned that state regulators should reject the proposed $67 billion merger between Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy unless residential base-rates are frozen.
why: Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy are major utility providers, and large utility mergers typically require extensive regulatory approval due to their regional market impacts.

impacts.name: Dominion Energy
impacts.why: State political opposition creates regulatory hurdles for the planned utility merger.

impacts.name: NextEra Energy
impacts.why: Conditional demands from state leaders introduce uncertainty into the acquisition timeline.
